newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse Air buys H.P. Srl for $5.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse Air buys H.P. Srl for $5.6 mln.

text.p: Westinghouse Air Brake Co said Tuesday it acquired H.P. Srl, an Italian manufacturer of car and bus door systems on July 31, for $5.6 million, including an assumption of debt.

The company said H.P. Srl provides a base for the sales not only of door systems, but other products, such as electronics, to the Italian market, and will complement its existing family of European operations which include Stone UK and Vapor UK in England and Cobra Europe in France.
H.P. Srl is expected to generate $5 million of revenue during the rest of 1997 and $15 million in 1998, added Westinghouse.
Westinghouse Air Brake is a manufacturer of electronic controls and monitors, air brakes, couplers, air conditioning, door controls, draft gears and brake.
